Objects: Put E=Euclidean R^I, S={x:||x||=1}, and V_j(x)=e_j-x_j*x, so [V_j(x)]_i=delta_ij-x_j*x_i. Write R_+=[0,infinity), and let lambda_T be Lebesgue measure on [0,T], transported to R_+ (the given comap of volume restricted to [0,T]). All time integrals below use this measure unless indicated otherwise. A ProgressiveL2Integrand eta on horizon T is a real process eta(t,omega), strongly progressive for the filtration, with (omega,t) -> eta(t,omega) in L^2(mu x lambda_T). The named constructor local_symbol_e7713243b878 packages the process sqrt(2*a(t))*[V_j(X(t,omega))]_i together with its progressive and L^2 proofs.

Domains: I finite with decidable equality; Omega measurable; filtration on R_+; mu finite; T>=0; X:R_+ x Omega->S; a:R_+->R; i,j in I; t>=0; omega in Omega.

Quantifiers: Universally spaces,instances,filtration,mu,T,X,hX,hProgressive,a,hTemperature,hBound,i,j,t,omega, in that order. Within hBound there exists C followed by forall t<=T.

Assumptions: X is jointly measurable and strongly progressive. a is measurable. There exists a real C with |a(t)|<=C for all t<=T. No nonnegativity of a or strict positivity of T is assumed.

Conclusion: The process field of local_symbol_e7713243b878(T,X,...,a,...,i,j), evaluated at (t,omega), equals sqrt(2*a(t))*(delta_ij-X_j(t,omega)*X_i(t,omega)).

Scopes: This equality is pointwise for every t>=0 and omega, including t>T. Real.sqrt is the total real square-root operation, hence zero on negative inputs. The L^2 claim built into the record is only on the product measure mu x lambda_T.

Constant dependencies: The existential bound C is uniform in t<=T and may depend on T,a; it is not a factor in the equality. The constructor depends on T,filtration,mu,X,a,i,j and their proof parameters; its process formula depends only on X,a,i,j.
